goal: Integrate reusable MIT implementation modules with full attribution; import no unauthorized upstream material images.

adaptations: Typed ES-module exports instead of a browser global.
Pure pixel quantization and safe local Canvas boundary.
React color controls and clipboard fallback replace upstream HTML rendering.

modules.scope: formatBrief only; library names and item normalization are not imported.
adaptations: Typed ordered nullable references and Traditional Chinese labels.
Built-in references resolve through BloomRender's own catalog and canonical public site.
Private upload slots use generic attachment placeholders; a separate action preserves existing prompt copying.

throughputCheckpoint.blockingFirstSteps: Read pinned upstream implementations and license, compare existing features, agree typed palette/reference-brief contracts before feature writes.
throughputCheckpoint.independentWorkstreams: One integration owner, disjoint palette and brief writers. Owner owns notices, provenance and Settings/PWA integration. Root owns browser coverage and independent review.
throughputCheckpoint.sharedMutableState: Separate feature components/styles/tests; no concurrent central locale or catalog edits. One pinned notice serves source, production and offline distribution.
throughputCheckpoint.smallestSafeDecomposition: Two small derived implementation modules with actual existing UI consumers; no whole upstream application, catalog, provider or generation engine.

layoutGate.waivers: Existing application-form and shared utility waivers unchanged. See evidence for each exact finding and reason.

visualChecks.screenshots: Local .taste-skill/shots/mit-* files; existing BloomRender CC0 materials and synthetic test fixtures only.

verification.privacy: Brief tests retain person/clothing/pose/lighting order, resolve built-in public URLs only, exclude local upload filenames/data/blob/session keys, and preserve exact manual prompt copying.
verification.clipboard: HEX and reference brief keep selectable text after permission denial; successful keyboard copying tested.
verification.palette: Real browser original-image extraction stays unchanged under CSS grayscale; pose/depth references hide the color palette. Unit tests cover transparent/white filtering, weighting, clustering, empty/canvas failure and stale material changes.

excluded: Upstream material catalogs and translated descriptions
Upstream local generation engines and provider integrations
